name: precorrect-only-model-bench-loo_problem-1-aug-1-1-batch0
description: A Hugging Face-hosted benchmark collection intended to evaluate model performance in a 'pre-correct only' setting using leave-one-out (LOO) splits and batch examples; it measures how well models predict corrected outputs from provided inputs under the dataset's specific augmentation/partitioning scheme. The benchmark is intended for model developers to compare correction or preprocessing model variants in a controlled LOO evaluation. Documentation and usage may be limited to the dataset author and early adopters.
evaluation_method: exact_match and token-level/F1-style comparison (e.g., string equality and token overlap); may also report aggregate accuracy
reputation: A small, author-hosted benchmark with limited community adoption beyond users of the hosting repository.
